items.q: What should you remember about **Stress ≠ purely negative**?
items.a: **acute epinephrine sharpens cognition,** narrows focus, primes immune defense; chronic elevation drives heart disease.

items.q: What should you remember about **Sympathetic chain**?
items.a: **neck-to-navel neurons → acetylcholine →** epinephrine/adrenaline; beta receptors activate muscles/heart, suppress digestion/reproduction → agitation designed for movement.

items.q: What should you remember about **Inhale vs exhale = heart rate lever**?
items.a: **inhale > exhale speeds heart (stress);** exhale > inhale slows heart via sinoatrial node ↔ brainstem parasympathetic loop.

items.q: What should you remember about **Physiological sigh mechanism**?
items.a: **double inhale reinflates collapsed alveoli; long** exhale clears CO₂ (agitation driver); works in real time, not a separate meditation practice.

items.q: What should you remember about **Vacation sickness pattern**?
items.a: **sustained adrenaline crash after chronic stress** → immune crash; don't let acute stress become chronic (sleep is the canary).

items.q: What should you remember about **Panoramic gaze during peak output**?
items.a: **stress dilates pupils → tunnel vision;** deliberately broadening gaze calms mind while body stays at 80–90% max (sports/military pattern).

items.q: What should you remember about **Social connection as neuromodulation**?
items.a: **recognizing trusted people releases serotonin →** immune/repair benefits; delight and play count; digital connection is a weak proxy.
